title: Crisis counseling immediate services request
description: A state request to the federal disaster partners for crisis counseling immediate services after a presidentially declared disaster: the disaster, affected area, population, services planned, providers and duration. The immediate services program lasts up to 60 days; the regular services program up to nine months. Everything is fictional and marked as an exercise product; a real helpline number never appears without the EXERCISE marking, and no real person or address is used.

subtitle.description: Line under the organization: unit, site, period

examples: Immediate services program, up to 60 days
Outreach, group support, shelter mental health tables

examples.services: Outreach, group support, shelter mental health tables

providers.description: Providers and how crisis counselors are trained and supervised
examples: Two community mental health centers; crisis counselors trained in psychological first aid and supervised by licensed clinicians.

duration.description: Dates and duration, with the program limits
examples: Nov 7, 2026 to Jan 5, 2027 (60 days). A regular services program application may follow, up to nine months.
